shina.title: The Flame That Won't Listen
lines: D-don't look! I just... lost control of my flames for a second.
Your hand is burned. Let me see.
It's nothing! A Dragon Monarch doesn't need bandages!
Then let a Commander wrap it anyway.
...Hmph. Just this once. And don't tell anyone.

shina.title: Dragon's Hoard
lines: Dragons keep treasure, you know. I've been collecting mine.
...Ribbons from every battle we won together. Don't laugh!
Y-you're so annoying. ...Will you give me another one tomorrow?

shina.title: Monarch's Oath
lines: My mother told me a Monarch bows to no one.
But I'd lower my head for you. Only for you.
I'd never ask you to bow.
I know. That's why... I'm choosing to stand beside you. Forever.
If you ever leave, I'll chase you across the sky. Understood?

xylia.title: Blueprint of a Smile
lines: I'm drafting a new fortress. Every wall has a purpose.
And this little room in the center?
...That one is yours. A place where you can rest.
Every empire needs a heart. Don't make it complicated.

xylia.title: Demolition Night
lines: Sometimes I want to tear everything down and start over.
Never us. You're the one structure I refuse to remodel.
Fufu. Don't tell the other demons, they'll think I've gone soft.

xylia.title: The Final Design
lines: I've finished my masterpiece. Want to see?
Because the future I want isn't one I can draw alone.
Let's design it together, Commander. Line by line.

micca.title: What's in the Box?
lines: Guess what's in my box today!
Wrong again! It's... a cookie I saved for you. Hehe!

micca.title: Chaos Picnic
lines: I planned a picnic! Totally normal, no chaos at all!
...Okay, a LITTLE chaos. But they're tasty!
You're the only one who never runs away from my chaos...

micca.title: The Bottom of the Box
lines: Everyone thinks there's something scary at the bottom of my box.
But it's just... hope. That's how the old story goes, right?
Because you're my hope, dummy. Now you know my biggest secret.
Promise you'll keep it safe? Pinky swear!

cthollia.title: Tentacle Trouble
lines: I'm sorry! My tentacles grabbed your coat again...
They... they reflect my feelings. That's what makes it embarrassing.
Then I don't mind at all.

cthollia.title: Song of the Deep
lines: Deep sea creatures sing to find each other in the dark.
My voice is strange... but okay. Just for you.

cthollia.title: Surfacing
lines: I stayed in the abyss for centuries. I thought light would hurt.
Then stay up here with me.
I will. And if the dark ever comes for you, I'll pull you out. With all eight arms.

valeria.title: Cold Hands
lines: Don't touch my hands. They're always freezing.
I learned it from an Empress.
Hm. ...Five more minutes. That's an order.

valeria.title: Empress Without a Throne
lines: My throne in Frostvale is empty. Snow covers it now.
Do you want to go back?
I used to. But a throne is lonely. A camp with you is not.
Perhaps. After we win, will you visit Frostvale with me?

valeria.title: The Spring of Frostvale
lines: Legend says spring returns to Frostvale when the Empress's heart melts.
Look outside. The first flower bloomed this morning.
Then rule beside me. Not as a subject. As my equal.

eropatra.title: Royal Tea
lines: You may serve me tea. Consider it an honor.
Hmph. Fine. You may sit and drink with me.

eropatra.title: The Serpent's Shed
lines: Serpents shed their skin to grow. Empresses... shed their pride.
It is. But in front of you, I don't need my crown.
Look at me. Just Eropatra. Do you still like what you see?

eropatra.title: Sands of Eternity
lines: My ancestors built pyramids to be remembered forever.
I don't need stone. I only want to be remembered by you.
Then it's a royal decree. Stay with me until the sands stop falling.

furu.title: Clumsy Prayers
lines: Kya! I dropped the holy water again...
I'm the Arch-Priestess, but I'm always so clumsy. The gods must be laughing.
...Thank you. Your words heal me more than any spell.

furu.title: Healer's Rest
lines: Healers aren't supposed to get tired...
C-can I lean on your shoulder? Just for a little while?

furu.title: A Prayer of My Own
lines: I always pray for others. Today I made a selfish prayer.
That I can stay by your side. Even when the war ends.
Is that... too much to wish for?

glytta.title: Dance Lesson
lines: Today I'll teach you a dance! Ready? One, two!
Ow, I stepped on your foot.
Hehe, it's fine! Crystal feet are tough!

glytta.title: The Cracked Crystal
lines: ...Oh, you found me. Look, one of my crystals cracked.
A little. Dancers aren't allowed to show pain on stage.
...Then I'll cry a little. Just for a minute. Stay?

glytta.title: Last Waltz
lines: The festival ends tonight. I saved the last dance for you.
No steps, no rules. Just us.
Promise me every last dance from now on, okay? Every single one!

hyeonxa.title: Nine Opinions
lines: My heads are arguing again. About you.
Three say you're foolish. Five say you're charming. One won't stop blushing.

hyeonxa.title: Antidote
lines: It's an antidote, fool. You were scratched yesterday and didn't tell me.
I notice everything about you. ...That's not a compliment.

hyeonxa.title: One Heart
lines: For the first time in centuries, all nine of my heads agree on something.
Don't make that face. Accept it gracefully, Commander.

scylla.title: Silent Company
lines: You've been sitting here for an hour.
...I like the quiet. And your breathing.

scylla.title: Tide Pool
lines: Look. A small fish trapped in a tide pool.
...I was like that fish once. Until you came.
I'll carry it back to the sea. Come with me.

scylla.title: Queen of the Deep
lines: Krakens don't have mates. We hunt alone.
But I don't want to be alone anymore.
...Then I'll stop hunting alone. You're mine now, Commander. That's how krakens love.

lumeira.title: Butterfly Messenger
lines: A butterfly told me you were sad today.
They tell me everything. So I came to cheer you up~

lumeira.title: Dream Walk
lines: Last night I walked into your dream. Sorry~
You were fighting alone. So I held your hand.
You don't have to be alone, even in dreams.

lumeira.title: Metamorphosis
lines: Butterflies were caterpillars once. They change completely.
I changed too, since meeting you. My wings feel lighter.
Then let's fly together. Wherever the stars lead us~

gemora.title: First Contact
lines: Query: what is this human ritual called 'holding hands'?
It means we trust each other.

gemora.title: Malfunction
lines: Commander, my systems report an error whenever you smile.
Heart rate +40%. Language module unstable. I-I-I think I like this error.

gemora.title: Signal Home
lines: My home planet sent a signal. They want me to return.
I sent my reply: 'Mission extended indefinitely. Reason: found something important.'
The important thing is you. Transmission complete.

fidelia.title: Night Watch
lines: Commander! You should be sleeping. I'm on watch.
B-but a knight shouldn't let her lord stay up...

fidelia.title: Dented Shield
lines: My shield has so many dents now.
This one... is from protecting you in Chapter 3. I'll never repair it.

fidelia.title: Knight's Vow
lines: Commander, please kneel. ...No, wait, I'm the one who should kneel!
Then hear my vow, standing as your equal: I will guard your life and your heart.
Not because it's my duty. Because I love you.

lucidria.title: The Wall Speaks
lines: Do you ever take a break?
You're not a wall. You're Lucidria.
...No one has said that in a thousand years.

lucidria.title: Flowers on Stone
lines: I found a flower growing between the stones of the old fort.
I thought of you. Something soft, surviving in a hard place.

lucidria.title: Unbreakable
lines: I have guarded ruins for ages. Ruins don't need guarding.
But you do. And I want to.
Then guard me. And let me guard you too.

eurnipha.title: Warm Hands
lines: Come here, little one. You look cold.
And I'm older than this world. Let me spoil you a bit.

eurnipha.title: Hunger of the Void
lines: The void inside me is always hungry. Always empty.
...No. When you're near, it's quiet. Full, even.

eurnipha.title: Embrace
lines: But I only want to hold you, gently.
...Ah. So this is what being full of warmth feels like. Don't let go.

rumi.title: Exorcist's Invoice
lines: Here's your bill for this month's exorcisms!
Hehe~ but for you there's a discount. 0.1%!

rumi.title: Haunted Heart
lines: I think I'm possessed. My heart beats weird around you.
I AM the exorcist! And... I don't want this one gone.

rumi.title: Free of Charge
lines: I've decided! From today, all services for you are free.
Because... you can't put a price on the person you love! There, I said it!
Now give me a hug as payment. That's the only fee!

mora.title: Stopped Clock
lines: Do you hear that? The clock tower stopped.
Just for a moment. I wanted this sunset to last a little longer with you.

mora.title: Sister's Diary
lines: I keep a diary of every timeline I've seen.
In every single one. In some you're a farmer, in some a king.
In all of them, I fall for you.

mora.title: Eternity's Answer
lines: I can see the end of time. It's quiet and cold.
But this moment, with you, is the warmest point in all of eternity.
Then let's make more moments like this.
Yes. Let's fill eternity with them, one by one.

abadonia.title: The Lion's Stable
lines: Do not approach my lion carelessly. He has eaten knights.
...Traitor. He has never purred for anyone but me.
Perhaps he senses what I sense. Hmph.

abadonia.title: A Queen's Armor
lines: Help me remove this armor. The clasp is stuck.
A queen carries the weight of her people. Every day.
Then let me carry some of it.
...You say the most foolish, wonderful things.

abadonia.title: Crown and Oath
lines: I have ruled the abyss for an age. I swore never to bow.
So I will not bow. I will offer my hand instead.
Then from today, my kingdom has two rulers. Do not disappoint me, my consort.

aqua.title: Spilled Water
lines: Ah! I spilled the holy water on your map...
You're too kind! Here, have a drink to make up for it!

aqua.title: Rain Dance
lines: It's raining! Come dance with me!
That's the fun part! Water is life, and you're... um... my life?

aqua.title: The Bottomless Chalice
lines: They say my chalice never runs dry. But my heart did, for a long time.
Then you came, and it overflowed.
Let me fill your cup for the rest of our lives, okay?

atalanta.title: The Race
lines: Race me to the tree! Loser buys dinner!
You're made of lightning. That's unfair.
Fine, I'll give you a ten-second head start! ...Go! ...Caught you!

atalanta.title: Static
lines: Ouch! Sorry, I shocked you again.
It's fine. It's kind of nice.
Nice? Weirdo! ...My lightning only sparks like that around you, you know.

atalanta.title: Standing Still
lines: I've never stopped running. Not once, my whole life.
But right now... I just want to stand still. Here, with you.
Okay. For you, I'll be the slowest girl in the world.

kali.title: Counting Swords
lines: This one? I found it by the river.
...Thank you. That sword was my mother's.
You carried it back all this way? You are a strange person.

kali.title: Lesson of the Blade
lines: Hold the sword like this. Gently. Like holding a bird.
...Yes. Your hands are warm. Don't let go yet.

kali.title: The Hundred and First
lines: A hundred blades, and I trusted none of them more than my own two hands.
Now I have a hundred and one. You are my newest blade.
Then let us never be sheathed apart.

zennyo.title: Dragon Daycare
lines: Can you watch my little dragons for an hour?
Sure. How hard can it be?
Fufu. They really do like you.

zennyo.title: Princess Lessons
lines: Father taught me to rule with fire and fear.
I think... I'd rather rule with warmth. Like the way you lead us.

zennyo.title: Dragon's Promise
lines: Dragons mate for life. Did you know that?
Now you do. ...Don't make me say it more plainly, Commander.
My dragons already call you 'papa', you know.

rubby.title: Bomb Friends
lines: Meet my friends. This is Boom, and this is Kaboom.
They're happy to meet you. Don't worry, they only explode when I ask nicely.

rubby.title: Quiet Night
lines: Everyone thinks I love loud things. Explosions, fireworks...
But I love quiet nights like this. With you.

rubby.title: The Biggest Firework
lines: I saved my biggest firework for a special day.
...It spells your name. Do you like it?

schylua.title: Frozen Breath
lines: Don't stand so close. You'll catch a cold.
...Foolish. Here, take my scarf. It's the only warm thing I own.

schylua.title: The Reaper's List
lines: Death gave me a list of souls to reap.
You were. I tore that page out.

schylua.title: Thaw
lines: My body is made of ice. Holding me will hurt.
...Strange. Your arms are warm, and I'm not melting.
Maybe I was waiting for someone like you to thaw me.

vexira.title: Dream Visit
lines: Ara~ Did you enjoy my visit in your dream last night?
Fufu, that's how it should be. Some secrets are sweeter kept.

vexira.title: Imp Trouble
lines: My imps stole your boots again. Sorry~
Why do they keep doing that?
They want you to stay longer. ...They take after me.

vexira.title: Real Feelings
lines: A succubus lives on desire. Love is supposed to be a game.
So why does this hurt so much when you're away?
Maybe it's not a game anymore.

siv.title: Hammer Practice
lines: I did?! I always miss! It must be because you're watching!

siv.title: Too Heavy
lines: This hammer is too heavy for me. Everyone says so.
But you carry it every day.
...Because I want to protect people. Like you.

siv.title: Lightning Strikes Twice
lines: They say lightning never strikes the same place twice.
But my heart keeps getting struck. Every time I see you.
That's a nice way to say it.
Eh?! Did I say that out loud?!

sven.title: Campfire
lines: Words are cheap. Fire is warm. Sit.

sven.title: The Broken Hilt
lines: This sword belonged to my old master. He died protecting me.
Don't be. He'd be glad I found someone worth protecting too.

sven.title: Wanderer's Rest
lines: I've walked across six kingdoms looking for a place to belong.
I think I can stop walking now.
...Home. I like the sound of that.

angela.title: Feathers on the Floor
lines: Don't laugh. I'm molting. Angels molt.

angela.title: The Volunteer
lines: Heaven asked for a guardian. Nobody else raised their hand.
I raised both hands. And my wings. ...I wanted it to be me.

angela.title: Golden Wings
lines: My wings turned gold today. That only happens when an angel finds where she belongs.
Right here. Beside you. Don't make me say it twice.

kara.title: The Reaper's Tea
lines: Even Death takes tea breaks. Sit.
Perfectly. I only reap people I dislike. Drink up.

kara.title: Phoenix Feathers
lines: The birds follow me because I keep bringing them back. Every time they burn, they rise.

kara.title: A Soul Worth Keeping
lines: I've seen every soul's ending. Yours is the only one I refuse to look at.
Because I want to be surprised. I want to spend all of it with you.

mei.title: The Sword Rack
lines: Every blade on this rack has a name. This one is 'Breakfast'.
Because I cut toast with it. Don't judge me.

mei.title: About the Ears
lines: Everyone asks if they're real. They are. They twitch when I'm nervous.

mei.title: Red Moon
lines: My blade burns red when I fight for someone I love.
...I know. It's been glowing since you walked in. Idiot.

ninger.title: Counting Coins
lines: Nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine... oh! You made me lose count!
Then you owe me one coin. Or... one smile. Smiles are worth more.

ninger.title: The Treasure Chest
lines: This chest holds my most precious treasure.
A pressed flower you gave me. ...Don't laugh! It's priceless!

ninger.title: A Thousand Coins
lines: I'd trade every coin I own for one more day like today.
You don't have to trade anything.
...Then I'm the richest princess in the world.

spimei.title: Maintenance Day
lines: My drones need oiling. Hold this wrench. No, the other end.
Efficient. You'd make a good engineer. ...Or a good partner.

spimei.title: Error: Heart
lines: My diagnostics show an anomaly. Heart rate elevated near you.
Unknown. I've decided not to fix it.

spimei.title: Scarlet Wings
lines: I built these wings to fly away from everyone.
Now I use them to fly back to you. Faster than any drone.

luby.title: Nap Thief
lines: That's my sunbeam. I was here first.
You were asleep on my desk.

luby.title: The Mecha Cat
lines: I built him from scrap. He purrs. Badly. It sounds like a blender.
...He likes you. He doesn't like anyone. Hmph.

luby.title: Nine Lives
lines: Cats have nine lives. I've used, like, six.
Then spend the rest with me.
...Nya. Okay. All three. Don't waste them.
